_doc: The prodigal son voice cast (docs/prodigal/VOICE.md). Schema: tools/story/voice.py docstring; breaths: voice_extras.py; `reverb` / `grid` / `mfccRef` are read by tools/story/voice_exodus.py, which tools/story/voice_prodigal.py (this pack's wrapper) imports. `designs` = alternative VoiceDesign descriptions auditioned (voice_prodigal.py audition ROLE LANG LINE --design N).

narrator.instruct: 一位温暖的女讲故事人，像妈妈在床边给四到十岁的孩子讲圣经故事，声音亲切、生动、自然，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：
narrator.why: same voice and note as Ruth / Esther / Exodus: one storyteller across the packs

son.design: 男性，二十岁左右的小儿子，大男孩。声音年轻、明亮、清亮，音调中等偏高，口齿清楚，说话轻快灵活，有点调皮、爱耍宝，情绪变化大，表情丰富。普通话标准。
son.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸声，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：
son.why: VoiceDesign young man; one person across 11 lines by the pitch pin and the timbre pin (reference: audition take pr_02 seed 0). CustomVoice `eric` was tried for stability and rejected: Sichuan accent (做->住, 饿->我) even when told to speak standard Mandarin

father.design: 男性，六十岁左右的爸爸，花白胡子的农庄主人。声音温暖、圆润、干净的男中音，一点也不沙哑、不粗糙，音色柔和明亮，说话慢慢的、轻轻的，非常慈祥、有耐心，常常带着笑意，感情很深，一动情声音就有点哽咽。身体硬朗，精神好。普通话标准。
father.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸声，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：
father.why: VoiceDesign, warm sixty, clean and round (not husky): the first, husky description came out 51 from Moses (inside his spread) and was replaced. Timbre reference: audition take pr_27 seed 0 (157 Hz, HNR 11 dB vs Moses 4.5); takes closer than 85 to Moses' centroid lose points. Not Boaz / Esther's king (uncle_fu).

brother.design: 男性，二十八岁左右的大儿子，天天下地干活的庄稼汉，大个子。声音低沉、厚重、有点粗哑，鼻音重一点，说话闷声闷气、慢吞吞、硬邦邦的，爱发牢骚，心里委屈。普通话标准。
brother.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸声，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：
brother.why: VoiceDesign, low, thick, a bit nasal and gruff; the earlier descriptions came out as high as the son (timbre 50 apart). Timbre reference: audition pr_26 seed 0 (129 Hz); kept away from the son's centroid.

friends.instruct: 几个年轻朋友一起说，嘻嘻哈哈、很自然，像真人。

servants.instruct: 两三个仆人一起高兴地答应主人，干脆、热情。

father.design: Male, about sixty, a kind farmer father with a grey beard. A clear, smooth, warm and gentle baritone, bright and soft, not gravelly, not husky, not rough at all; patient and unhurried, often smiling as he talks; his feelings run deep and his voice catches when he is moved. Healthy and full of life. Standard American English.
father.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, not stagey, real breaths, normal flowing pace. This line:
father.why: Qwen VoiceDesign, not edge: he laughs through tears (pr_21) and his voice catches (pr_03); the deep multilingual edge voices are taken (Andrew = Boaz, William = Exodus God / Daniel's king). Clear, smooth description after the first (husky) one came out 36 from en Moses. Timbre reference: audition pr_21 seed 1; kept away from Moses' centroid.

zh.son.instruct: 用标准普通话说，不带四川口音、不说方言，字音清楚。像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸声，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：

zh.brother.design: 男性，二十六七岁的大儿子，天天下地干活的青年农夫。声音偏低、结实、粗一点、有点闷，说话直来直去、硬邦邦的，爱嘟囔、有点倔，心里委屈。普通话标准。
zh.brother.note: first description: 184-215 Hz, as high as the son; replaced

zh.brother.design: 男性，二十六七岁的大儿子，天天下地干活的青年农夫，大个子。男中低音，嗓音粗、厚、胸腔共鸣足，音调偏低，说话慢一点、闷声闷气、硬邦邦的，爱嘟囔、有点倔，心里委屈。普通话标准。
zh.brother.note: second description: timbre 50 from the son; replaced

zh.father.design: 男性，六十岁左右的爸爸，花白胡子的农庄主人。声音温暖、柔和、醇厚的中低音，略带一点沙哑，说话慢慢的，非常慈祥、有耐心，感情很深，一动情声音就有点哽咽。身体硬朗，声音不虚弱、不发抖。普通话标准。
zh.father.note: first description (husky): timbre 51 from Moses' centroid, inside both spreads; replaced 2026-11-14

en.father.design: Male, about sixty, a kind farmer father with a grey beard. A warm, soft, mellow baritone with a little husk, gentle and patient, unhurried; his feelings run deep and his voice catches when he is moved. Healthy and strong, not frail, not shaky. Standard American English.
en.father.note: first description (a little husk): timbre 36 from en Moses; replaced
